title: Use a consistent alignment for all text items in a list

statement.en: Choose or apply a consistent alignment for all text items in a list in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況ではa consistent alignment for all text items in a listを採用する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Right to left experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるRight to leftの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
